Model and setting generalization diagnostics

Source: R/csdg_documentation.R, R/csdg_generalization.R
csdg_generalization.Rd

These functions separate robustness across near-equivalent models from predictive generalization across prespecified setting shifts.

Usage

csdg_rashomon(
  task,
  learners,
  resampling,
  primary_measure = NULL,
  tolerance_absolute = NULL,
  tolerance_relative = NULL,
  tolerance_source = NULL,
  tolerance_rationale = NULL,
  reference_learner = NULL,
  seed = 20260201L,
  store_models = TRUE
)

csdg_near_equivalence_sensitivity(
  x,
  tolerance_absolute = NULL,
  tolerance_relative = NULL,
  tolerance_source = NULL,
  tolerance_rationale = NULL,
  reference_learner = NULL,
  direction = c("auto", "minimize", "maximize"),
  scenario_id = NULL
)

csdg_rashomon_agreement(rashomon, pfi, top_k = 10L)

csdg_leave_one_group_out(
  task,
  learner,
  group,
  measures = NULL,
  seed = 20260201L,
  store_models = FALSE
)

csdg_transport_status(
  scores,
  measure,
  direction = c("maximize", "minimize"),
  minimum_transport_score = NULL,
  maximum_transport_score = NULL,
  criterion_source = NULL,
  criterion_rationale = NULL
)

Arguments

task

An mlr3::Task.

learners

Named candidate learners.

resampling

Identical instantiated splits for all learners.

primary_measure

Primary measure key or object.

tolerance_absolute, tolerance_relative

Prespecified near-equivalence tolerances. For csdg_near_equivalence_sensitivity(), either value may be a vector defining a sensitivity grid; vector lengths must be one or equal to the number of scenarios.

tolerance_source

Source of the supplied near-equivalence tolerance.

tolerance_rationale

Rationale linking the supplied tolerance to the claim.

reference_learner

Optional learner name around which the tolerance is defined. When omitted, the direction-specific best candidate is the reference.

seed

Random seed.

store_models

Whether to store fitted learners.

x

A CSDGRashomon object or candidate table with unique learner_name and finite mean_score columns.

direction

Whether higher or lower scores are better.

scenario_id

Optional unique labels for the tolerance scenarios.

rashomon

A CSDGRashomon object.

pfi

Named permutation-importance results for accepted learners.

top_k

Number of top-ranked feature groups.

learner

The learner whose results are compared across settings.

group

One setting identifier per task row.

measures

Performance measures.

scores

Setting-level score table.

measure

Column to evaluate.

minimum_transport_score

Minimum acceptable score for maximized metrics.

maximum_transport_score

Maximum acceptable score for minimized metrics.

criterion_source

Source of a supplied transport criterion.

criterion_rationale

Rationale linking a supplied transport criterion to the claim.

Value

Structured candidate, agreement, or leave-one-group-out results.
